title: Bomberman DOM
tagline: An online Bomberman for 2 to 4 players at 60 fps, on plain DOM elements and our own mini-framework.
summary: A multiplayer Bomberman for 2 to 4 players in the browser. There is no canvas and no WebGL: the whole game is made of DOM elements, rendered by a mini-framework we wrote ourselves and animated with requestAnimationFrame at 60 fps. Players meet in a lobby with timers, chat in real time, pick up power-ups and have 3 lives each.
problem: Make a smooth real-time game with the DOM only, which was never designed for games, and keep 2 to 4 players in sync over the network.
